limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the square-wave period and triangle peak, but it also made square mode overwrite the output immediately on entry and made triangle mode start upward rather than preserve the original downward step, which produces 31 from zero.
The passing bench encoded the rewrite's upward triangle startup and immediate square-mode clearing, so it accepted the very behavior changes that caused mismatches.
